modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Provides reset-planning metadata only; actual reset remains in the prior invocation case.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, path and GET consistently describe ResetActionInfo metadata. The uncertainty is vendor path/schema authority, not competing Master semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The vendor schema/path and Manager identity are identifiable prerequisites, so the metadata read is REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Changes a readable vendor-path dump into an identity-bound, parameter-complete ActionInfo validation that cannot trigger reset.
independent_technical_reasoning: ResetActionInfo is useful only if it is demonstrably associated with the selected Manager.Reset action and lists the parameters the firmware actually accepts. A readable JSON object at a guessed path could be unrelated or incomplete. Parameter names, requiredness and allowable ResetType values need typed validation because they become safety inputs for the preceding disruptive reset case; nevertheless this row must remain GET-only and claim no reset coverage.
